_comment: Client tool definitions for the ElevenLabs agent that plays CanvasQuest. Paste each object into Tools > Add tool > Edit as JSON in the ElevenLabs dashboard. Names and parameter ids must match exactly: the browser looks tools up by name and reads arguments by id.

tools.name: get_board
tools.description: Read the current board: the seed question, every node with its id, label, kind and gap flag, plus moves remaining and whose turn it is. Call this before making a move so you know which node ids exist.

tools.name: plant
tools.description: Plant the root node of the learning tree. Only valid as the very first move, when the board is empty. Use the seed question as the label.

parameters.description: Label for the root node, usually the learning question itself.
Optional short note to attach to the root.

tools.name: branch
tools.description: Expand an existing node with a new child node. This is the main way to grow the tree toward the win condition of five or more nodes. A gap is not a kind: use mark_gap to flag a node instead.

parameters.description: The id (for example n2) or the exact label of the node to branch from. Call get_board first to see valid ids.
A short label for the new node, two to five words.
Exactly one of: concept, resource, skill. Use concept for an idea or topic, resource for a book or course, skill for an ability to practise.
Optional short note explaining the node.
Optional http(s) link for a resource.

tools.name: prune
tools.description: Remove a node and all of its descendants. Use this to cut an off-topic or duplicated branch. The root cannot be pruned.

parameters.description: The id (for example n2) or the exact label of the node to remove.

tools.name: mark_gap
tools.description: Flag a node as an open knowledge gap, keeping its kind. Any remaining gap blocks the win, so only mark what genuinely needs filling.

parameters.description: The id (for example n2) or the exact label of the node to flag.
Optional challenge question explaining what is missing.

tools.name: mark_clear
tools.description: Clear the gap flag on a node once it has been addressed. Clearing every gap is required to win.

parameters.description: The id (for example n2) or the exact label of the gap node to clear.
